questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

The news __are true.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'is true​.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the word 'News' is information about something that has happened recently

 
 
• Example: *Have you had any news from Naina recently?*

 
 
 
 
 
• *​*'News' is a noun, which looks plural, but is used as 'singular'.
 
• Therefore, the use of 'are true' should be replaced by 'is true' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'is true​.'
 
• Correct sentence__:* The news **is true**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• Countable nouns, as the term suggests, refer to things that can be counted.
 
• They have singular and plural forms.
 
 
• Example: *table, tables; month, months; pen, pens.*
 
 
 
• Uncountable nouns cannot be counted.
 
• They have a singular form and do not have a plural form.
 
 
• Example: *dirt, rice, information, furniture, and hair.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• Word 'News' का अर्थ समाचार, ख़बर है।

 
 
• Example: *Have you had any news from Naina recently?*
 
 
 
• *​*'News' एक संज्ञा है, जो 'plural' दिखती है, लेकिन 'singular' के रूप में प्रयोग की जाती है।
 
• इसलिए वाक्य में 'are true' के प्रयोग को 'is true' से बदल देना चाहिए ताकि वह व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही हो।​

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Ram introduced Shyam to everyone and then served snacks to them.

B. After he cut the cake, all of them danced for a long time.

C. When Shyam reached his house, his classmates had already arrived.

D. Ram invited his friend Shyam on his birthday.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DCAB.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 __
 
• The first statement in the sequence should be **D** because it is introducing the subject 'Ram.'
 
• C follows D because it is talking about the arrival of Ram's friend Shyam.
 
• A follows C because it is talking about the introduction of Shyam to everyone.
 
• **B** provides a conclusion to the story.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is 'DCAB.'
 
• ​​The correct sequence__:​

D. Ram invited his friend Shyam on his birthday.

C. When Shyam reached his house, his classmates had already arrived.

A. Ram introduced Shyam to everyone and then served snacks to them.

B. After he cut the cake, all of them danced for a long time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** **
 

 

 

__
 
• Steps for solving Para Jumbles:
 
 
• Clues include pronouns, like he, she, it, this, that, these, those; adverbs like formally, really; article a, an and the; definers like actually, finally, another; connectors like but, yet, both, also and neither nor, or, however, nevertheless.
 
• Now, with the help of clues, try to find out qualifier and qualified sentences, so that we can make pairs of qualified and qualifier sentences to eliminate the wrong choices given in the question.
 
• After making pairs, start eliminating the wrong choices or options given in the question.
 
• In case there is more than one choice, try to follow the sequence of sentences according to the occurrence of the events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• विकल्पों में दिए गए गद्यांश के भागों को व्यवस्थित करते समय, हमें उनके बीच कुछ व्याकरणिक या प्रासंगिक संबंध खोजने होंगे, तो आइए जानें।
 
• अनुक्रम में पहला कथन D** होना चाहिए क्योंकि यह subject 'Ram' का परिचय दे रहा है।
 
• **C, D का अनुसरण करता है** क्योंकि यह राम के मित्र श्याम के आने की बात कर रहा है।
 
• **A, C का अनुसरण करता है** क्योंकि वह सभी से श्याम के परिचय की बात कर रहा है।
 
• B कहानी को निष्कर्ष प्रदान करता है।
 
• इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर 'DCAB' है।

questions.question:

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e., **'****Sorrow****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Delight** is a **noun** that means **(something or someone that gives) great pleasure, satisfaction, or happiness**. ((कोई चीज या कोई जो देता है) बहुत खुशी, संतुष्टि, या खुशी)
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Sorrow** - (a cause of) a feeling of great sadness (क्रूर, हिंसक, और पूरी तरह से भावनाओं के बिना)
 
• **Joy** - great happiness(एक सभ्य समाज या देश में सरकार, संस्कृति और जीवन शैली की एक अच्छी तरह से विकसित प्रणाली होती है और जो वहां रहने वाले लोगों के साथ उचित व्यवहार करती है)
 
• **Glee** - a feeling of happiness, usually because something good has happened to you or something bad has happened to somebody else (उल्‍लास का भाव (क्‍योंकि आपके साथ अच्‍छा हुआ या दूसरे के साथ बुरा हुआ))
 
• **Pleasure** - a feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment. सुखद संतुष्टि और आनंद की भावना।
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that **Sorrow** is the correct antonym for the word **Delight**.

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

I was given a robot by him.

options.text: A robot by him was given to me

questions.solution:

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Past Tense and Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Past Tense from Passive voice to Active voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Structure__: Object+ was/were V3 + by + subject __(Passive Voice)__

 Subject + V2 + object __(Active Voice)__ 
 __
 
• Example: *The floor was cleaned by Reema.** *(Passive Voice)

 *Reema cleaned the floor.** *(Active Voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'He gave me a robot.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 *A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)*​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Simple Past Tense और Passive Voice में है।
 
• Simple Past Tense को Passive voice से Active voice में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का Object, Passive Voice का Subject बन जाता है।
 
• संरचना__: Object+ was/were V3 + by + subject __(Passive Voice)__

 Subject + V2 + object __(Active Voice)__ 
 
 
• Example: *The floor was cleaned by Reema.** *(Passive Voice)

 * Reema cleaned the floor.** *(Active Voice)
